opening.argument: The material presents Forsage BUSD as a route to $1,000 monthly income while directing viewers toward paid cryptocurrency or wallet-based participation. Its structure is a recruitment-driven matrix: the displayed x3 and x4 positions, along with xGold, sponsor or line-based benefits, downline upgrades, and repeated recycling, frame continued returns as dependent on expanding participation. The narration makes that dependence explicit, stating, “You will get income from your team or from upline or crossline,” and referring to a downline whose upgrade improves the participant’s position. WhatsApp referral activity further promotes recruitment. These displayed returns and stability-related claims are promotional, not independently verified, and the material does not establish completed transactions or realized earnings.
